versions.changelog:
- Updated to version 1.2.0.
- scripts/index.js modified (details not provided).
- No visible user-facing changes to documentation.
Fix: use appian.json env fallback (consistent with other skills); save artifacts to ~/appian-exports/ instead of ~/.openclaw/exports/; correct security section in SKILL.md

Initial release of appian-deploymtstatus.

- Check the status of an Appian deployment using its UUID.
- Optionally poll for status updates until completion.
- Download deployment log and package ZIP artifacts with flags.
- Credentials are securely read from environment variables only.
- All files are saved locally; no data is uploaded externally.
